About Sami Rahman

Md. Sami Rahman is a detail-oriented and reliable professional from Mirpur, Dhaka, with experience in customer communication, data entry, data management and digital marketing.

He is proficient in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, internet research and MS Presentation, and is skilled in fast, accurate typing and in keeping data organised and correct.

Through the Fiverr Marketplace (2021 - 2023) he worked with international clients, handling their requirements, managing projects and delivering services on time. He brings strong communication, problem-solving and time-management skills, and a commitment to accuracy and professionalism.

He is currently studying Electrical and Electronic Engineering at American International University-Bangladesh.
